source.title: Training Dynamics of Deep Network Linear Regions
source.authors: Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun; Randall Balestriero; R. Baraniuk

record.file_problem: none; the full paper text is present.
record.tranche_reason: The paper trains networks and measures training and test accuracy alongside local partition complexity, including conditions with random labels. These outcomes bear on V1, but it does not report training classification error values or test whether the networks reach near-zero error.
record.gate_note: The paper reports accuracy curves in figures for MNIST and CIFAR-10 experiments. These rows record only explicit text descriptions of accuracy outcomes; figure-only accuracy values are not reconstructed. Local-complexity results do not themselves measure the claim and are omitted. The CIFAR-10 result says accuracy peaks during ascent and is sustained during second descent; no classification-error values are stated.
record.test_reason: The study reports its own CIFAR-10 CNN training-accuracy curves, which bear on V1 in a setting focused on partition dynamics. However, the supplied text gives neither readable accuracy values nor an explicit near-zero training-error result, so no directional verdict is justified.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is broadly accurate: the authors identify phases of local partition complexity, associate them with memorization and generalization, and observe partition boundaries migrating toward decision boundaries late in training. These dynamics depend on architecture and regularization. They do not establish zero or near-zero training classification error.
record.recipe_differences: The paper studies local partition complexity and accuracy dynamics during training, rather than directly testing whether gradient training reaches zero or near-zero classification error under the claim's recipes.
record.method_sensitivity: Local-complexity dynamics differ with architecture, width, batch normalization, weight decay, depth during grokking, and training-data label and sample-count conditions; the text does not establish corresponding changes in training classification error.

fits_no_version.finding: MNIST MLP train and test accuracy peak during the initial local-complexity descent.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Accuracy timing is associated with partition-complexity phases in MNIST MLP training.

fits_no_version.finding: Batch normalization increases local partition complexity and suppresses its second descent in CIFAR-10 CNNs and ResNet18.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Batch normalization changes partition geometry during training; this does not establish faster optimization or higher learning-rate tolerance.

record.code_released: not stated; the authors say the codebase will be publicly released upon completion of the review process.
record.problems: The evidence for the claim is indirect: the paper reports accuracy timing but no numeric training-error results in the text. Accuracy results are shown in figures without stated values. Most experiments use MNIST; CIFAR-10 experiments are described, but CIFAR-100 is not studied. The text does not specify optimizer or initialization for these experiments.
record.rows_left_out: Omitted local-complexity results because they do not measure training classification error. Omitted accuracy curves in Figures 8–11 where the text does not state an accuracy outcome; exact values are figure-only and cannot be reconstructed. Random-label accuracy outcomes are likewise not stated in the text.

untested.parts: CIFAR-100; corrupted or random labels in convolutional CIFAR networks; the specified SGD/Adam and random-initialization recipes; and whether smaller models, early stopping or regularization leave substantial training error. MNIST random-label MLP experiments do not test these conditions.
Teacher-student ReLU optimization, spurious-minimum frequencies and extra student neurons.
Training-error degradation with depth and its prevention by identity shortcuts or special initialization.
Initialization comparisons measuring learning speed or trainable depth.
Learning-rate stability thresholds, curvature dynamics, recovery and divergence.
Batch normalization's effects on accuracy gain per training step and learning-rate tolerance; normalization-free Fixup comparisons.

record.verdict_notes: The supplied text contains figure captions but no readable accuracy curves. Missing numeric accuracy values prevent a V1 verdict; they do not demonstrate absent or partial optimization. The record already declares omitted figure-only and random-label accuracy outcomes.

versions.untested_parts: The text does not report zero or near-zero training classification error, compare SGD with Adam, or test CIFAR-100, corrupted labels, or small models and early stopping. MNIST random-label experiments are described, but their training-accuracy outcome is not stated in text.

rows.subject: fully connected DNs (depth in {2, 3, 4, 5}, width 200)
rows.operation_detail: Trained while monitoring train and test accuracy; text reports accuracy peaks during the first local-complexity descent phase at all tested depths.
rows.value: For all the depths, the accuracy on both the train and test sets peak during the first descent phase.
rows.note: Accuracy peak timing is reported, but no classification-error values or final error are given.
rows.check: These are fully connected networks on MNIST, outside V1's convolutional CIFAR setting. Peak timing also cannot establish near-zero training error. Train and test accuracy should be separate measures.

rows.subject: CNNs with varying depths
rows.size_stated: varying depths; exact values not stated
rows.operation_detail: Trained while monitoring train and test accuracy; text reports accuracy peaks in the local-complexity ascent phase and is sustained during the second descent.

conditions.value: CNN with convolutional layers and one fully connected layer before output

rows.value: The network train and test accuracy peaks during the ascent phase and is sustained during the second descent.
rows.note: This is a timing description, not an error measurement; the text does not give values or say whether training error approaches zero.
rows.check: The text establishes when accuracy peaks, but gives no peak or final training-accuracy value. Separate training accuracy from test accuracy and distinguish depth and batch-normalization conditions before drawing verdicts. The optimizer and initialization are unspecified.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
